title: Stop Paying for Claude Code
description:
Most developers are spending hundreds of dollars per month on Claude Code.

This GitHub project takes a different approach.

Instead of sending requests directly to Claude, it routes them through alternative models like:

• DeepSeek
• Kimi
• GLM
• Local Ollama models

Setup takes minutes:

• Install the repo
• Choose a provider
• Connect your API key or local model
• Start coding

The result is a Claude Code-style workflow at a fraction of the cost.

For developers building every day, reducing AI costs can make a huge difference.

Check the pinned comment for the full guide.
